User Story: External Notification Provider Configuration & Management

Title :

Configure and Manage External Notification Providers for World Cup Platform

User Story :

As a World Cup Platform Administrator,
I want to configure and manage external notification providers through the Admin Portal, so that the platform can securely deliver tournament notifications, match reminders, live match events, and result updates through integrated platforms such as Banky Lite and Bus without requiring code changes.


Description :

The system shall provide a centralized notification provider configuration module that allows administrators to configure external notification delivery endpoints and control how tournament-related notifications are sent.

The platform shall support integration with external notification services through configurable APIs, enabling each tenant to manage its own notification settings independently.

The solution shall include both Admin Portal configuration screens and backend services responsible for notification orchestration, delivery management, retry handling, and event processing.

Acceptance Criteria :

Notification Provider Configuration :

  1. The system shall provide a dedicated Notification Configuration screen within the Admin Portal.

  2. Administrators shall be able to configure:

    • Provider Name

    • Base URL

    • Endpoint Path

    • Authentication Type

    • Authentication Headers

    • Credentials

    • Custom Headers

    • Request Payload Template

    • Timeout Configuration

  3. The system shall support multiple authentication mechanisms including:

    • No Authentication

    • API Key

    • Bearer Token

    • Basic Authentication

  4. Configuration data shall be stored securely.

Tenant-Specific Configuration :

  1. Each Tenant shall maintain an independent notification provider configuration.

  2. Changes made by one tenant shall not affect other tenants.

  3. The system shall display the current provider status.

  4. The system shall indicate whether a tenant configuration is active and valid.

Notification Event Management :

  1. Administrators shall be able to independently enable or disable:

    • Match Result Notifications

    • Match Reminder Notifications

    • Match Unlock Notifications

  2. Event activation settings shall be configurable per tenant.

  3. The system shall apply the configured settings automatically without requiring deployment.

Backend Notification Processing :

  1. The backend shall generate notification requests automatically based on tournament events.

  2. The backend shall support:

  • Match Reminder Notifications

  • Match Result Notifications

  • Match Participation Notifications

  • Match Availability Notifications

  1. The backend shall construct notification payloads using configurable templates.

  2. The backend shall invoke the configured external notification API.

  3. The backend shall validate responses returned from external providers.

  4. Failed notification requests shall be logged for operational review.

Reminder Management :

  1. Administrators shall be able to configure a reminder window in hours.

  2. The platform shall automatically trigger reminder notifications before prediction deadlines.

  3. Reminder calculations shall respect the configured reminder window.

Monitoring & Audit :

  1. The system shall record all outbound notification requests.

  2. The system shall store:

  • Notification Type

  • Event Type

  • Request Timestamp

  • Delivery Status

  • Response Code

  • Error Details

  1. Administrators shall be able to review notification execution history.

Expected Business Outcome :

  • تمكين إدارة إشعارات البطولة من خلال شاشة إعدادات مرنة.

  • دعم الربط مع Banky Lite و Bas وأي منصة مستقبلية دون تعديلات برمجية.

  • التحكم الكامل في أنواع الإشعارات المرسلة لكل Tenant.

  • دعم إشعارات النتائج والتذكير وفتح المباريات للتوقع.

  • تقليل الاعتماد على التعديلات البرمجية عند تغيير مزود الإشعارات.

  • توفير منصة جاهزة للتشغيل متعدد المستأجرين (Multi-Tenant Notification Integration).

User Story: BAS User Auto Registration and Single Sign-On Integration

As a Mobile User accessing the World Cup Prediction Platform from BAS Super App,
I want to seamlessly access the World Cup Prediction module without creating a separate account, so that I can immediately participate in predictions using my existing BAS identity and profile information.

Description :

The World Cup platform shall integrate with BAS authentication and user information services to support automatic user registration and Single Sign-On (SSO).

When a user launches the World Cup module from BAS, the platform shall retrieve the user identity and profile information from BAS, automatically create or update the user account in the World Cup platform, authenticate the user, and issue the required access token to the prediction package without requiring any additional login steps.

This integration shall provide the same user experience currently available for Banky Lite users.

Acceptance Criteria :

Authentication & Authorization

  1. The World Cup platform shall support BAS authentication integration using the BAS SDK and authentication APIs.

  2. When a user launches the World Cup module from BAS, the application shall obtain the BAS authorization code.

  3. The backend shall exchange the authorization code for authenticated user information through BAS APIs.

  4. The platform shall validate the received authentication data before processing the user session.

Automatic User Registration

  1. If the user does not exist in the World Cup platform, the system shall automatically create a new user account.

  2. The platform shall store the required user information received from BAS.

  3. If the user already exists, the system shall update the user profile information when applicable.

  4. The platform shall maintain the relationship between the World Cup user account and the BAS user identifier.

Automatic Login

  1. After successful authentication, the platform shall automatically sign in the user.

  2. The platform shall generate and return the required access token to the mobile package.

  3. The user shall not be required to enter any additional credentials.

  4. The user shall be redirected directly to the prediction platform home screen after successful authentication.

User Information 

  1. The platform shall retrieve the user profile information from BAS using the authenticated user APIs.

  2. The platform shall maintain data consistency between BAS and the World Cup platform.

Multi-Tenant Support

  1. User registration and authentication shall be associated with the correct tenant configuration.

  2. The platform shall support independent BAS integration settings per tenant.

Security

  1. All authentication requests shall be performed through secure APIs.

  2. The platform shall not expose BAS authentication credentials to the mobile application.

  3. User sessions shall be managed using secure access tokens.

  4. Authentication and registration activities shall be logged for auditing purposes.

Technical Scope

Included Work:

  • Add BAS SDK integration.

  • Implement BAS authorization code flow.

  • Retrieve authenticated user information from BAS.

  • Auto-register World Cup users.

  • Auto-login and token generation.

  • Update PWA and Flutter package to support BAS auth-code flow.

  • Support the same onboarding experience currently implemented for Banky Lite users.

Business Value

  • Increase user adoption and participation rates.

  • Provide a frictionless Single Sign-On experience.

  • Reuse existing BAS customer identities.

  • Enable immediate access to prediction features with minimal user interaction.

User Story: Match Details, Team Statistics, and Live Match Events

Title

View Match Details, Team Statistics, and Live Events


User Story :

As a Banky Lite or BAS user,
I want to view detailed information about a selected match, including team statistics, team information, and live match events, so that I can make more informed predictions, follow match progress in real time, and better understand the performance of the competing teams.

Description :

The platform shall provide a comprehensive Match Details screen that displays match information, participating teams, historical and tournament statistics, live match events, and current match status.

Users shall be able to access this information before, during, and after the match based on data synchronized from the sports data provider.


Acceptance Criteria :

Match Information

  1. The system shall provide a Match Details screen for each published match.

  2. The screen shall display:

    • Match name.

    • Tournament or competition.

    • Match stage (Group Stage, Round of 16, Quarter Final, etc.).

    • Match date and time.

    • Match status.

    • Venue information (if available).

  3. The platform shall display both competing teams with:

    • Team name.

    • Team logo.

    • Country flag.

    • FIFA ranking (if available).

Team Statistics

  1. The system shall display statistical information for both teams.

  2. Statistics may include:

    • Matches played.

    • Wins.

    • Draws.

    • Losses.

    • Goals scored.

    • Goals conceded.

    • Clean sheets.

    • Recent form.

  3. Statistics shall be retrieved from the integrated sports data provider and periodically synchronized to the platform database.

  4. The platform shall display comparative statistics between both teams whenever available.

Team Information

  1. The platform shall display additional team information including:

    • Team coach.

    • Team captain.

    • Squad overview.

    • Tournament performance.

  2. The platform shall support future expansion to display player-level statistics.

Live Match Events

  1. The platform shall display live match events during ongoing matches.

  2. Supported event types shall include:

  • Match Started.

  • Goal Scored.

  • Penalty Awarded.

  • Penalty Scored.

  • Penalty Missed.

  • Yellow Card.

  • Red Card.

  • Substitution.

  • VAR Decision.

  • Injury Time.

  • Half Time.

  • Full Time.

  1. Events shall be displayed in chronological order.

  2. Each event shall display:

  • Event time.

  • Event type.

  • Team.

  • Player information (if available).

  • Event description.

  1. The platform shall automatically refresh live events while the match is in progress.

Live Match Status

  1. The platform shall display the current match score.

  2. The platform shall show:

  • Match minute.

  • Match status.

  • Current score.

  • Possession statistics (if available).

  1. Match status shall automatically update based on provider data.

Prediction Integration

  1. Users shall be able to navigate directly from the Match Details screen to the prediction screen when predictions are still open.

  2. If predictions are closed, the system shall display the prediction closing status.

  3. The platform shall indicate whether the user has already submitted a prediction for the selected match.

Guest & Registered Users

  1. Match details and statistics shall be available to both guest users and authenticated users.

  2. Live events and match information shall be viewable without requiring a prediction submission.

  3. Prediction actions shall remain restricted to authenticated users only.

Mobile Experience

  1. The screen shall be optimized for Flutter package integration within Banky Lite and BAS.

  2. Team logos, country flags, and live events shall load efficiently with minimal impact on application performance.

  3. The user experience shall be similar to international sports applications while remaining consistent with the World Cup Prediction Platform design standards.

Business Value :

  • Improve prediction accuracy by providing richer match insights.

  • Increase user engagement before and during matches.

  • Encourage users to spend more time within the prediction platform.

  • Deliver a professional sports experience comparable to global prediction and sports applications.

  • Increase participation rates through informed decision-making.

User Story: Prediction Experience Enhancements and User Feedback Improvements

As a World Cup Platform User,
I want the prediction platform experience to be more accurate, transparent, and user-friendly, so that I can easily browse matches, understand the scoring system, manage my predictions, and participate more effectively in the competition.


Description :

Based on user feedback and business review sessions, several enhancements shall be implemented across the Match Schedule, Prediction, Leaderboard, and Referral modules to improve usability, correctness, engagement, and transparency.


Acceptance Criteria :

Match Filtering & Browsing

  1. The platform shall provide filtering capabilities on the match listing screen.

  2. Users shall be able to filter matches by:

    • Tournament stage.

    • Match status.

    • Available for prediction.

    • Completed matches.

    • Today's matches.

  3. The platform shall display the tournament stage for each match, such as:

    • Group Stage.

    • Round of 16.

    • Quarter Finals.

    • Semi Finals.

    • Third Place Match.

    • Final.

  4. Match stage information shall be synchronized from the competition data source and displayed consistently across all screens.

Prediction Accuracy & Data Corrections

  1. The platform shall correct the issue causing team names, flags, or positions to appear reversed between the match schedule and prediction screens.

  2. Team information displayed in:

    • Match List.

    • Match Details.

    • Prediction Screen.

    • Shared Links.

    shall always remain consistent.

  3. The platform shall validate home and away team mappings before publishing matches for prediction.

Prediction Management

  1. The platform shall allow users to modify their predictions before the prediction deadline.

  2. Prediction editing shall automatically close when the prediction lock period is reached.

  3. The system shall maintain a complete audit history of prediction updates.

  4. The latest submitted prediction shall be considered the active prediction.

Scoring Transparency

  1. The platform shall provide a dedicated screen explaining how points are calculated.

  2. The scoring guide shall be configurable through the Admin Portal.

  3. Users shall be able to clearly understand:

  • Exact score prediction points.

  • Winner prediction points.

  • Draw prediction points.

  • Bonus points.

  • Referral rewards.

  • Special campaign rewards.

  1. The scoring explanation shall be accessible from:

  • Prediction Screen.

  • Leaderboard.

  • User Profile.

Leaderboard Sharing Controls

  1. Users shall only be allowed to share their leaderboard ranking after an official ranking has been calculated.

  2. The platform shall prevent sharing leaderboard positions that have not yet been determined.

  3. Shared leaderboard links shall always display the latest valid ranking information.

Referral & Social Engagement Rewards

  1. The platform shall support awarding points for successful referral-based participation.

  2. Referral reward rules shall be configurable through the Admin Portal.

  3. The system shall support configurable point allocation for:

  • User registrations through referral links.

  • First prediction submission by referred users.

  • Participation campaigns.

  • Social sharing campaigns.

  1. The platform shall track referral performance per tenant.

  2. Referral points shall be reflected in the user's total score and leaderboard ranking.

Administration & Configuration

  1. Administrators shall be able to configure:

  • Prediction editing rules.

  • Match filtering options.

  • Leaderboard sharing permissions.

  • Scoring rules.

  • Referral reward points.

  1. All configurations shall support multi-tenant isolation and independent management per tenant.

Expected Business Outcome

  • Improve prediction accuracy and user trust.

  • Increase user engagement and participation.

  • Reduce user confusion regarding scoring and rankings.

  • Encourage viral growth through referral incentives.

  • Improve discoverability of matches through advanced filtering.

  • Enhance overall user experience before the official World Cup launch.

User Story: Match Experience Enhancements and Real-Time Data Improvements

User Story

As a World Cup Platform User,

I want a faster, more accurate, and richer match experience across the mobile application,

So that I can easily follow live matches, access complete match details, make predictions, and receive up-to-date information without delays or inconsistencies.

Description :

Based on production testing and user feedback, several enhancements are required to improve the match listing experience, live match updates, match details, prediction accessibility, event presentation, and overall data synchronization between the backend services and mobile applications.

The enhancements shall improve usability, real-time visibility, and data accuracy throughout the World Cup prediction platform.

Acceptance Criteria :

Match Prediction Accessibility

  1. The mobile application shall display a Predict action directly on upcoming matches displayed on the home screen.

  2. Users shall be able to navigate directly from the match card to the prediction screen.

  3. The Predict action shall only be available for matches that are still open for predictions.

Live Match Visibility

  1. The platform shall reduce delays in displaying live matches on the home screen.

  2. Matches that have started shall automatically appear in the Live Matches section according to the configured refresh interval.

  3. Live match information shall be synchronized automatically with the latest available match data.

Match Details Enhancements

  1. Team statistics shall be displayed correctly for both competing teams within the match details screen.

  2. The platform shall display all available team statistics received from the match provider.

  3. Country names shall be displayed alongside team information.

  4. Stadium information shall be displayed within the match details screen whenever available.

  5. Team flags shall be displayed correctly across all match details screens.

Live Events Improvements

  1. Match events shall be presented in a structured and user-friendly format.

  2. Events shall be categorized and displayed using clear visual indicators, including:

  • Goals.

  • Penalties.

  • Yellow Cards.

  • Red Cards.

  • Substitutions.

  • VAR Decisions.

  • Own Goals.

  • Match Start.

  • Half Time.

  • Full Time.

  1. Events shall be sorted chronologically according to match time.

Match Status Synchronization

  1. The platform shall automatically update match statuses according to the latest provider updates.

  2. Match status transitions shall correctly reflect:

  • Scheduled.

  • First Half.

  • Half Time.

  • Second Half.

  • Extra Time.

  • Penalty Shootout.

  • Finished.

  • Cancelled.

  • Postponed.

  1. Matches entering the second half shall automatically update to the correct match status.

  2. Match status updates shall be reflected consistently across:

  • Home Screen.

  • Match List.

  • Match Details.

  • Prediction Screens.

Real-Time Score and Match Refresh

  1. Match scores shall be refreshed automatically without requiring users to reopen the application.

  2. Match details shall be refreshed according to the configured synchronization interval.

  3. The platform shall reduce delays between backend updates and mobile application display.

  4. Live scores, events, and match status shall remain synchronized across all screens.

Data Consistency

  1. The same match shall not appear with conflicting information across different screens.

  2. Match results, scores, statuses, statistics, and events shall always reflect the latest available backend data.

  3. The platform shall handle temporary synchronization failures gracefully and retry updates automatically.


Business Value

  • Improve user engagement during live matches.

  • Increase prediction participation rates.

  • Enhance confidence in live match data accuracy.

  • Reduce user complaints related to delayed updates.

  • Provide a richer and more professional World Cup experience.

  • Improve overall platform quality before large-scale user adoption.

User Story

I want penalty-decided matches to use the approved penalty scoring tiers,

so that my prediction is scored fairly when the winner is decided after penalties.


Business Context :

  • Extra-time outcomes.

  • Penalty shootout winners.

  • Exact score predictions.

Title

Submit Match Predictions for Available World Cup Matches

User Story

As a Registered Mobile User, I want to submit predictions for available World Cup matches, so that I can participate in prediction competitions and receive points based on prediction accuracy.

Description

The platform shall allow authenticated users to predict match outcomes using either:

  • Exact score prediction

  • Winning team prediction

When the user predicts match scores, the system shall automatically determine the predicted winning team based on the entered result.

Prediction rules, scoring policies, and point calculations shall be configurable from the Admin Portal.

The system shall automatically validate predictions against live match results and continuously update prediction statuses.

Acceptance Criteria :

Prediction Types

  1. The system shall allow registered users to submit predictions using:

    • Exact score prediction

    • Winner-only prediction

  2. Users shall be able to enter predicted goals for both competing teams.

  3. When score prediction is entered, the system shall automatically determine:

    • Winning team

    • Draw result if applicable

Prediction Validation

  1. The system shall allow predictions only for matches marked as available for prediction.

  2. The system shall prevent guest users from submitting predictions.

  3. The system shall automatically stop accepting predictions 5 minutes before match kickoff.

  4. The system shall validate duplicate prediction rules based on configured platform policies.

Prediction Management

  1. ​Prediction rules and scoring policies shall be configurable from the Admin Portal.

  2. Administrators shall be able to configure:

    • Prediction points

    • Winner prediction scoring

    • Exact score scoring

    • Bonus rules

    • Prediction availability rules

    • Re-submission permissions

  3. Predictions shall be isolated per tenant within the multi-tenant platform.

Automatic Result Processing

  1. The platform shall automatically calculate prediction results after match completion.

  2. The system shall compare predictions against actual match results.

  3. Prediction status shall automatically update to:

  • Correct

  • Incorrect

  • Pending

  • In Progress

  1. During live matches, the platform shall continuously synchronize match results and update prediction statuses automatically.

  2. Users shall be able to view:

  • Their submitted predictions

  • Prediction result status

  • Earned points

  • Match outcomes

Security & Performance

  1. Only authenticated users shall be allowed to submit predictions.

  2. The platform shall validate user authentication tokens before accepting predictions.

  3. Prediction APIs shall support high concurrent usage during major matches.

  4. The mobile package shall dynamically load tenant-specific prediction configurations and scoring rules.

Title

Send Real-Time Match Notifications with Deep Link Support Across Integrated Applications

User Story

As an Administrator, I want to send real-time notifications related to matches, goals, match results, and tournament activities, so that users stay engaged and instantly informed about important World Cup prediction events and updates.


Description  :

The World Cup Prediction platform is integrated as a reusable Flutter package , via mian app :

  • Banky Lite

  • BAS Super App

Since push notification management is handled by the host applications, the prediction platform backend shall integrate backend-to-backend with Banky Lite and BAS notification systems.

The platform shall:

  • Generate and send notification payloads

  • Pass deep links and metadata

  • Allow host applications to manage Firebase delivery and in-app notifications

  • Support navigation into the prediction package using deep links

Notifications shall support:

  • Match reminders

  • Match start alerts

  • Goal notifications

  • Match result notifications

  • Ranking updates

  • General broadcast notifications


Acceptance Criteria :

Notification Management

  1. The platform shall provide Admin Portal screens for managing prediction notifications.

  2. Administrators shall be able to create:

    • Instant notifications

    • Scheduled notifications

    • Match-event notifications

    • Broadcast notifications

    • Tenant-specific notifications

  3. Notification types shall include:

    • Match reminders

    • Match started

    • Goal scored

    • Match finished

    • Prediction results

    • Leaderboard updates

    • Tournament announcements

Backend-to-Backend Integration

  1. The prediction platform shall integrate backend-to-backend with:

    • Banki Lite notification services

    • BAS Super App notification services

  2. The platform shall send notification payloads to the host applications instead of directly managing Firebase delivery.

  3. Host applications shall manage:

    • Firebase push notifications

    • Device tokens

    • Notification delivery

    • Mobile notification rendering

  4. The platform shall support tenant-aware notification routing.

Deep Link Support

  1. Notifications shall support secure deep links into the prediction package.

  2. Deep links may navigate users to:

    • Specific match

    • Prediction page

    • Match result

    • Leaderboard

    • Tournament page

  3. When users click the notification inside Banki Lite or BAS:

  • The host application shall open the prediction package.

  • The deep link shall be passed to the Flutter package.

  • The package shall navigate to the intended destination accurately.

  1. Deep links shall support signed or secured parameters where required.

General Notifications

  1. The system shall support sending general broadcast notifications to:

  • All users

  • Specific tenants

  • Specific tournaments

  • Selected user segments

  1. Administrators shall be able to control:

  • Notification priority

  • Delivery timing

  • Notification visibility

  • Tenant targeting

Match Event Automation

  1. The platform shall support automatic notification generation based on live match events.

  2. Automated notifications may include:

  • Match kickoff

  • Goals scored

  • Half-time updates

  • Match completion

  • Prediction outcome updates

  1. Automated notifications shall use synchronized match data from the platform backend.

Security & Permissions

  1. Notification APIs shall require authenticated and authorized access.

  2. Cross-tenant notification leakage shall be prevented.

  3. Deep links and notification payloads shall validate tenant and user context before navigation.

  4. The platform shall log notification activities for audit and troubleshooting purposes.

User Experience

  1. Notifications shall support localized and multilingual content.

  2. Notifications containing deep links shall seamlessly redirect users into the intended prediction content.

  3. If the user is not authenticated, the platform shall complete authentication before opening the target deep-link destination.

  4. The notification experience shall remain consistent across Banki Lite and BAS Super App integrations.

User Story — Seamless World Cup Prediction Access from Banki Lite

Title

Enable Seamless Access and Auto Registration for World Cup Prediction Package from Banki Lite

User Story

As a Banky Lite user, I want to open the World Cup 2026 prediction package directly from Banky Lite and be automatically registered and logged into the prediction platform using my existing Banky Lite account information, so that I can start using prediction features without separate registration or login steps.

​

Description :

The World Cup 2026 Predictions platform is integrated into Banky Lite as a reusable Flutter package.

When the user clicks the World Cup icon inside Banki Lite:

  • The prediction package shall open directly inside the application.

  • The platform shall perform automatic registration using OAuth2 and Get User Info APIs.

  • The user referral code from Banky Lite shall be shared during registration.

  • The platform shall automatically authenticate the user and issue a prediction platform access token.

  • The generated token shall be returned to the Flutter package to enable seamless prediction usage without additional login steps.

This integration ensures smooth onboarding and unified user experience between Banky Lite and the Predictions platform.


Acceptance Criteria :

Package Launch Integration

  1. The system shall allow users to open the World Cup Prediction package directly from Banky Lite.

  2. Clicking the World Cup icon inside Banky Lite shall launch the embedded Flutter prediction package.

  3. The prediction package shall initialize using the active authenticated Banky Lite session.

User Authentication & Registration

  1. The system shall use OAuth2 authentication for secure integration between Banky Lite and the Predictions platform.

  2. During first access, the platform shall automatically register the user باستخدام بيانات Get User Info القادمة من Banky Lite.

  3. The registration request shall include:

    • User basic information

    • Unique user identifier

    • Mobile number

    • Referral code from Banky Lite

    • Tenant information if applicable

  4. The platform shall support automatic user creation without requiring manual signup.

Referral Code Integration

  1. The Get User Info response from Banky Lite shall include the user referral code.

  2. The Predictions platform shall store and associate the referral code with the registered prediction user profile.

  3. Referral information shall be available for future campaigns, rewards, or referral tracking.

Auto Login & Token Exchange

  1. After successful registration or user validation, the system shall automatically authenticate the user into the Predictions platform.

  2. The Predictions platform shall generate an access token for the authenticated user.

  3. The generated token shall be securely returned to the Flutter package.

  4. The Flutter package shall use the token for all authenticated prediction APIs and operations.

  5. Users shall access prediction features without additional login screens.

Security & Session Management

  1. All authentication and token exchange operations shall use secured APIs and encrypted communication.

  2. The system shall validate OAuth2 tokens before processing registration or login requests.

  3. The platform shall prevent duplicate user creation for already registered Banky  Lite users.

  4. User sessions shall follow platform authentication and token expiration policies.

Multi-Tenant Support

  1. The registration and authentication process shall support multi-tenant architecture.

  2. The system shall identify the source tenant/application during auto registration and login processing.

  3. Tenant-specific settings and branding shall load dynamically inside the prediction package.

User Story  — Match Synchronization & Automated Match Updates

Title

Integrate and Synchronize World Cup Matches from SportMonks API

User Story

As a Platform Administrator, I want the system to automatically synchronize World Cup 2026 matches from SportMonks and continuously update match data and statuses, so that prediction data remains accurate and up to date across all tenants and mobile applications.


Description :

The platform integrates with the SportMonks Football API to retrieve World Cup 2026 match schedules, participating teams, and match updates.

The system must:

  • Fetch match schedules automatically
  • Store match data locally in the database
  • Continuously synchronize match status updates
  • Update participating teams and stages
  • Support scheduled background synchronization jobs

This functionality ensures reliable and optimized match access without depending on real-time API calls from the mobile application.


Acceptance Criteria :

External API Integration

  1. The system shall integrate with the SportMonks World Cup API to retrieve football match data.
  2. The integration shall retrieve:
    • Match schedules
    • Match dates and times
    • Match statuses
    • Tournament stages
    • Participating teams
    • Team details
  3. Retrieved data shall be stored داخل قاعدة البيانات المحلية للمنصة.

Background Synchronization

  1. The system shall implement scheduled background jobs for automatic synchronization of match updates.
  2. Background jobs shall periodically:
    • Update match statuses
    • Refresh match schedules
    • Synchronize stage changes
    • Update participating teams
    • Detect postponed or canceled matches
  3. Synchronization failures shall be logged for monitoring and troubleshooting.

Match Management

  1. The system shall organize matches based on tournament stages.
  2. The platform shall support retrieving matches by:
    • Stage
    • Date
    • Team
    • Match status
    • Tenant visibility
  3. Match data shall be exposed through secured APIs for mobile applications and frontend portals.

Performance & Reliability

  1. Mobile applications shall consume locally stored match data instead of directly calling external APIs.
  2. The synchronization process shall avoid duplicate match creation.
  3. The system shall preserve historical match data and update only changed information.

User Story  — Manual Match Editing & Sche​dule Override

Title

User Story

As an Administrator, I want to manually update and override synchronized match data from the Admin Portal, so that I can correct scheduling or match information when external API updates fail or contain inaccurate data.

Description :

In some operational cases, synchronized data from SportMonks may become delayed, unavailable, or inaccurate. Administrators must be able to manually override match information to maintain operational continuity and prediction accuracy.

The system must support controlled editing of synchronized matches without breaking synchronization integrity.

Acceptance Criteria :

Match Editing

    • Match date and time
    • Match status
    • Tournament stage
    • Team information
    • Visibility settings
    • Tenant availability
  3. The system shall record audit information for all manual modifications.

Synchronization Override

  1. The system shall support manual override mode for selected matches.
  2. Matches marked as manually overridden shall not be automatically overwritten by synchronization jobs unless explicitly allowed.
  3. Administrators shall be able to restore synchronized values if required.

Reliability & Operations

  1. The system shall maintain prediction integrity after manual modifications.
  2. Manual updates shall immediately reflect in:
    • Mobile applications
    • Prediction APIs
    • Match listings
    • Admin dashboards
  3. The platform shall log synchronization conflicts and manual override actions for operational tracking.

User Story — Share Match, Prediction, and Leaderboard Ranking

Title

Share Matches, Predictions, and Leaderboard Rankings Using Secure Deep Links

User Story

As a User, I want to share a specific match, my prediction, or my leaderboard ranking, so that I can invite other users, increase engagement, and allow others to directly open the shared content inside the World Cup prediction package integrated with Banky Lite.

Description :

The platform shall support secure deep-link sharing between:

  • Banky Lite

  • The embedded Flutter prediction package

  • Shared prediction content

Users shall be able to share:

  • Match pages

  • Prediction details

  • Leaderboard rankings

  • Tournament standings

The backend platform shall generate secure deep links and return them to the mobile application.

When another user opens the shared link from Banky Lite:

  • Banky Lite shall route the request into the prediction package.

  • The package shall accurately navigate to the intended content.

  • The system shall securely validate access permissions before displaying prediction details.

The deep link structure must include enough identifiers to prevent conflicts or incorrect routing.

Acceptance Criteria :

Share Functionality

  1. The mobile application shall allow users to share:

    • Matches

    • Match predictions

    • Leaderboard rankings

    • Tournament standings

  2. Shared content shall generate secure deep links from the backend platform.

  3. The backend shall return the generated deep link to the mobile application.

Deep Link Handling

  1. Banky Lite shall support opening prediction deep links داخل الباكج الخاصة بمنصة التوقعات.

  2. The prediction package shall handle deep links and navigate users directly to:

    • Specific match

    • Specific prediction

    • Specific leaderboard ranking

    • Tournament page

  3. The navigation process shall accurately resolve shared content without incorrect routing.

Deep Link Structure

  1. Deep links shall include secured identifiers such as:

    • Match ID

    • Tournament ID

    • Tenant ID

    • User ID

    • Prediction ID

    • Ranking ID if applicable

  2. The system shall validate deep link integrity before displaying content.

  3. Deep links shall prevent manipulation attempts such as:

    • Prediction modification

    • Unauthorized ranking access

    • Cross-tenant access

    • Invalid content access

Referral Integration

  1. Shared deep links shall include the user referral code associated with Banky Lite.

  2. The referral code shall be passed during onboarding of new users entering through shared links.

  3. The platform shall support referral tracking for:

  • New registrations

  • User acquisition campaigns

  • Engagement analytics

Security & Permissions

  1. The platform shall manage permissions for viewing prediction details of other users.

  2. Users shall only view shared prediction information allowed by platform privacy policies.

  3. The platform shall support configurable privacy levels for:

  • Public predictions

  • Friends-only visibility

  • Private predictions

4. All shared links shall use secured tokenized or signed deep-link mechanisms where required.

User Experience

  1. Opening shared links from Banky Lite shall automatically open the prediction package if installed and integrated.

  2. The prediction package shall load shared content seamlessly without requiring manual navigation.

  3. If the user is not authenticated, the system shall complete authentication first before redirecting to the intended shared content.

  4. Shared content loading shall support tenant-aware routing and configuration loading automatically.

Required Changes  Add Competition and CompetitionSeason entities, repositories, DTOs and permissions. Convert appsettings into repeatable initial seeding that does not overwrite administrative settings.

items.description:
As a platform operator, I want to migrate existing fixtures to verified seasons while preserving predictions and points, so that multi-season operation does not lose or misclassify historical data.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  Before enabling the expansion, match fixture IDs from seasons 26618 and 26998 against documented evidence. Do not default every row to LeagueId 732 or one SeasonId.
2  After backfill, every active fixture has a verified season. Quarantine unclassified rows and produce a remediation report; do not publish unclassified records.
3  Prediction, outcome, point-ledger and reward counts and relationships remain identical before and after migration. Migration performs no deletion or recalculation.
4  After Redis is flushed, visibility remains database- and tenant-setting based. A rollback test restores the previous scope without deleting new seasons.

Required Changes  Use a staged nullable migration, followed by backfill, constraints and indexes. Replace ActiveSeasonFixtureScope with CompetitionSeasonScope and remove cached fixture IDs as the authoritative visibility source.

Dependencies  BE01; complete before releasing new-season functionality.

items.itemName: Multi Season Data Synchronization
items.description:
As a platform operator, I want shared synchronization to process each enabled season independently, so that all competitions remain current without duplicated tenant-level provider calls.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  With three enabled seasons, GetFixtures, GetTeams, GetStages, GetTournamentGroups and GetStandings use the correct season identifier for each call.
2  If one season fails, retain its last successful data, record the failure and continue other seasons. Do not delete data because of a failure or incomplete response.
3  On job retry or concurrent instances, locking prevents overlapping logical work and upserts remain idempotent. Logs include SeasonId, Provider and CorrelationId.
4  When a season ends and is archived, stop recurring synchronization but retain its data. LiveScores remain shared; FixtureDetail is retrieved by external fixture identifier.

Required Changes  Update SportMonksOptions, IMatchDataProvider, SportMonksMatchDataProvider, MatchDataSyncJob and FixtureDetailSyncJob. Resolve livescore fixture IDs against the catalog before updating them.

Dependencies  BE01 and BE02.

items.itemName: Shared Provider Budget and Sync Health
items.UDF_CHAR4: Shared Provider Budget and Sync Health
items.UDF_CHAR3: Shared Provider Budget and Sync Health
items.description:
As a platform operator, I want all seasons to share the provider account budget and expose sync health, so that concurrent tournaments do not exhaust provider limits or hide stale data.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  When two seasons request the same requested_entity under one account, reserve capacity from one shared quota; each season must not receive an independent copy of the full limit.
2  On HTTP 429, honor retry or reset metadata and defer nonessential work with backoff. Prevent rapid retries and manual refresh bypassing the budget.
3  During concurrent live matches across competitions, avoid season starvation, prioritize live and final-result updates, and expose reasons for deferred standings and catalog work.
4  Health responses show last successful sync, remaining quota, reset, stale and deferred status per bucket and season. Alert after 90 seconds of live-fixture staleness, identifying any deferral reason.

Required Changes  Update SportMonksRateLimitBudgetService, distributed reservations and Redis keys. Configure a documented account-level ceiling and expose a lower operational limit when needed.

Dependencies  BE03; verify the provider account quota scope in the test environment.

items.itemName: Tenant Competition Entitlements
items.description:
As a Super Admin, I want to assign competition access and defaults to each tenant, so that users only participate in competitions their tenant is entitled to offer.

Acceptance Criteria:

1 When saving tenant settings, validate WorldCup.TenantLeagues.Manage and plan coverage for every competition. Tenant Admins cannot expand their own subscription.
2 Selected with an empty list exposes no competitions; AllEntitled exposes authorized competitions only. Migrated tenants retain their previous scope and are not automatically assigned Starter access.
3 On plan change or competition disablement, reject invalid defaults, invalidate caches and review new jobs. Keep historical results and predictions stored.
4 Concurrent setting changes use concurrencyStamp to prevent overwriting newer changes. Bootstrap returns a new configuration version after saving. Required Changes Add EntitlementResolver and CompetitionAccessPolicy. Use ABP Settings or a consistent typed table, with a transition plan for EnabledLeagueIds and SubscribedPlan. Dependencies BE01; approve selection modes and subscription rules.

items.itemName: Competition Aware Reads and Prediction Validation
items.UDF_CHAR4: Competition Aware Reads and Prediction Validation
items.UDF_CHAR3: Competition Aware Reads and Prediction Validation
items.description:
As a tenant user, I want every match and prediction endpoint to respect my competition and season scope, so that navigation and participation remain consistent and authorized.
Acceptance Criteria:
1 With a seasonId filter, fixtures, detail, community stats, my predictions and admin predictions use the same competition, season and tenant scope.
2 Direct or shared requests for an unauthorized fixture return the same not-found response. Hiding its card in the interface is insufficient.
3 On Submit or Update, derive the season from the fixture and reject predictions at T-10 minutes, for TBD fixtures or for seasons not open for predictions, even if the interface is stale.
4 With all request filters omitted, return authorized results only, using pagination and deterministic ordering.

DTOs carry full context and conflicting scope parameters are rejected.
Required Changes Update FixtureAppService and its extensions, AdminFixtureAppService, PredictionAppService, AdminPredictionAppService, DTOs and bootstrap. Preserve the existing prediction request body.

Dependencies BE02 and BE05.

items.itemName: Season Scoring Streaks and Leaderboards
items.description:
As a player, I want independent season rankings and deterministic scoring, so that predictions across concurrent competitions do not mix streaks or produce duplicate points.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  Season rankings use outcomes from that season's fixtures. Overall aggregates only available seasons in the published scope; friends rankings apply the same scope and dense-rank semantics.
2  A correct Premier League prediction followed by an incorrect La Liga prediction does not affect the Premier League streak under the proposed new-season policy. Equal kickoff times are ordered by a stable fixture identifier.
3  Finalization, retry and recompute create no duplicate outcomes or awards. Late results deterministically recalculate the same season's sequence without moving points between seasons.
4  WinnerOnly penalty fixtures retain existing CURRENT, PENALTIES, ExactPenalty and CorrectPenalty rules. Enabling a competition does not retroactively change points or reward balances.

Required Changes  Update the scoring resolver, streak state, EfCorePredictionOutcomeRepository, leaderboards, friends rankings and reporting. Keep leaderboard aggregates separate from any redeemable reward balance.

Dependencies  BE02 and BE06; approve season-specific streaks and historical point preservation.

items.itemName: As a Product Owner / Innovation Lead , I want to build a prototype Flutter package for World Cup 2026 predictions (similar to 360 experience) , So that I can validate the concept, user experience, ...
items.description:
User Story: World Cup 2026 Predictions Prototype (Flutter Package)

As a

Product Owner / Innovation Lead

I want to

build a prototype Flutter package for World Cup 2026 predictions (similar to 360 experience)

So that

I can validate the concept, user experience, and integration approach before full-scale development, and easily plug it into apps like Bas and Banky Lite


Description

هذا العمل يركز على تطوير Prototype (MVP خفيف) لموديول التوقعات خاص بـ FIFA World Cup 2026، بحيث:

  • يكون Flutter Package قابل للدمج وليس تطبيق مستقل

  • يركز على التجربة (UX/UI) والـ Flow أكثر من التكامل الكامل

  • يستخدم Mock APIs أو بيانات ثابتة في المرحلة الأولى

  • يوضح شكل المنتج النهائي من ناحية الاستخدام


Acceptance Criteria

1. Prototype Scope

  • يجب أن يكون المخرج Prototype فقط (غير Production-ready)

  • لا يشترط تكامل كامل مع Backend (يمكن استخدام Mock Data)

  • التركيز على:

    • تجربة المستخدم

    • تدفق الشاشات (User Flow)

2. Package Structure

  • يجب تطويره كـ Flutter Package

  • يمكن استدعاؤه داخل أي تطبيق (Bas / Banky Lite)

  • يجب أن يعمل بدون تعارض مع التطبيقات المستضيفة

3. Core Screens (UI Prototype)

يجب توفير الشاشات التالية:

  • شاشة قائمة المباريات

  • شاشة إدخال التوقع

  • شاشة عرض التوقعات الخاصة بالمستخدم

  • شاشة Leaderboard (تجريبية)

4. User Experience

  • تصميم حديث مشابه لتجربة 360

  • دعم:

    • Animations بسيطة

    • انتقالات سلسة

  • تصميم قابل للتخصيص (ألوان / Branding بسيط)

5. Data Handling

  • استخدام:

    • Mock Data أو Static JSON

  • لا يشترط:

    • Authentication

    • Real-time updates

6. Integration Readiness

  • يجب أن يكون الكود:

    • Modular

    • قابل للتحويل لاحقاً إلى Production بسهولة

  • تعريف Interfaces للـ APIs (حتى لو غير مربوطة فعلياً)


Expected Outcome

  • نموذج أولي واضح لتجربة المستخدم

  • إمكانية عرضه على:

    • Stakeholders

    • Business Team

  • تسريع اتخاذ القرار قبل الاستثمار الكامل

  • تقليل المخاطر في مرحلة التطوير الفعلية

 Prototype Success Criteria (Important)

  • هل التجربة جذابة للمستخدم؟

  • هل سهلة الدمج داخل التطبيقات الحالية؟

  • هل تستحق التطوير الكامل؟

items.itemName: As developers,We want to initialize the project using the ABP framework,So that we can establish a scalable, modular, and maintainable architecture that accelerates development and ensures best practices.
items.description:
Acceptance Criteria:

1. ABP Project Setup

  1. Given the need for a structured and modular framework,
    when we initialize the project,
    then it must be created using the latest stable version of the ABP framework.
  2. The project must follow a multi-layered architecture (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, UI) to ensure maintainability.
  3. The team should choose the appropriate UI technology (MVC, Blazor, Angular, or React) based on project requirements.

2. Database and ORM Configuration

  1. The system must be configured with Entity Framework Core as the ORM.
  2. A relational database (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle) must be selected and configured.
  3. Database migrations must be applied to set up the initial schema.
  4. The Unit of Work and Repository patterns must be implemented following ABP standards.

3. Authentication & Authorization Setup

  1. The project must integrate Identity Server for authentication and authorization.
  2. Role-based access control (RBAC) must be implemented to manage user permissions.
  3. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) must be configurable via Identity Server settings.
  4. The ability to extend and customize user profiles must be available.

4. Multi-Tenancy Support 

  1. Given the platform may need to serve multiple organizations,
    when multi-tenancy is enabled,
    then each tenant must have isolated data and configurations.
  2. The system should support both database-per-tenant and shared-database models based on project needs.

5. API and Modular Development

  1. Given the need for a structured backend,
    when APIs are implemented,
    then they must follow ABP modular application standards.
  2. Swagger must be enabled for API documentation.
  3. Core services such as user management, logging, and notifications must be implemented as ABP modules.

6. UI Setup (If Frontend is Required)

  1. The UI must be initialized using the selected frontend technology (Angular, React, MVC, Blazor).
  2. The frontend must integrate seamlessly with backend APIs for authentication and data retrieval.
  3. Role-based UI components must be implemented to ensure proper access control.

7. Logging & Monitoring

  1. Serilog must be configured for centralized logging.
  2. Application health checks must be implemented for monitoring system performance.
  3. Logs should be stored in a persistent location for debugging and auditing.

8. CI/CD & Deployment Setup

  1. Given the need for continuous integration,
    when code is pushed to the repository,
    then an automated pipeline should run tests and build the project.
  2. The project must have CI/CD pipelines configured using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps.
  3. The deployment process should support staging and production environments.

Technical Notes:

  1. Codebase Structure:

    • The project must follow the DDD (Domain-Driven Design) approach.
    • Core business logic must be placed in Application and Domain layers.

  2. API & Backend Development:

    • Implement modular application services to avoid monolithic architecture.
    • Ensure RESTful API practices and consistency in error handling.

  3. Security Best Practices:

    • Enable CORS to allow cross-origin requests securely.
    • Implement OAuth 2.0 & OpenID Connect via Identity Server.
    • Secure sensitive configuration using environment variables.

  4. Performance Considerations:

    • Implement caching strategies for frequently accessed data.
    • Optimize database queries using indexing.

Testing and QA:

  1. Unit Testing:

    • Write unit tests for core business logic.
    • Achieve a minimum of 80% test coverage in critical modules.

  2. Integration Testing:

    • Ensure APIs are working correctly with frontend applications.

  3. Security Testing:

    • Perform penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities.
    • Validate role-based access control implementation.

  4. Performance Testing:

    • Ensure the system scales well under high load.
    • Optimize API response times to be under 200ms for critical endpoints.

items.itemName: League Cup and Stage Formats
items.description:
As a player, I want each competition to use its correct stage and prediction format, so that league rounds, cup groups and knockout matches are presented and scored correctly.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  For leagues without groups, return league standings and round information without requiring GroupId. Group tournaments return separate standings for each group.
2  Resolve knockout stage identifiers from the provider per season instead of reusing hardcoded World Cup identifiers. TBD fixtures remain locked.
3  Accept draw predictions for stages that allow draws. Reject draws server-side for WinnerOnly stages and return PredictionMode and lockReason to the interface.
4  For two-leg ties or missing aggregate data, do not treat the first leg as qualification confirmation. Display available facts without adding a new qualification prediction market to this scope.

Required Changes  Update Stage, Group and Standings mappings and contracts with format, round and predictionMode. Reuse the approved penalty rules with fixture data.

Dependencies  BE03 and BE06; verify the stage format before enabling each competition.

items.itemName: Season Context Notifications and Sharing
items.description:
As a player, I want notifications and shared results to carry the correct competition and season context, so that I return to the intended match without receiving duplicate or unauthorized messages.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  Result, reminder, unlock, goal, own-goal and red-card notifications include fixture, competition and season in their copy and links. Yellow-card notifications remain excluded.
2  On job retry, a tenant, user, fixture, event and trigger key prevents duplicate delivery, and each tenant's settings are applied.
3  Opening a deep link after authentication revalidates tenant access and the fixture. A plan change results in a safe unavailable message.
4  Notification delivery across multiple competitions remains bounded and exposes backlog metrics. Never log authentication keys, tokens or sensitive data.

Required Changes  Update notification-job arguments, templates, the share resolver and deep links. Notification processing must not add provider calls. Preserve Banky/BAS authentication and queued friend synchronization.

Dependencies  BE05, BE06 and BE07.

items.itemName: Competition Reports Cache and Realtime Consistency
items.UDF_CHAR4: Competition Reports Cache and Realtime Consistency
items.UDF_CHAR3: Competition Reports Cache and Realtime Consistency
items.description:
As a tenant administrator, I want reports and realtime updates to use the same season scope as user APIs, so that operational totals and user rankings remain consistent.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  Season-filtered ranking and engagement report totals match the APIs for the same tenant and scope. Exports identify competition, season and date range.
2  Correcting a fixture result invalidates affected overall, season, friends and report caches only. Other tenants remain unaffected.
3  SignalR updates include fixtureId, competitionId, seasonId and configVersion without exposing another tenant's user information.
4  Overall responses keep display filters separate from historical reward balances. Removing access must not cancel an existing redemption or create a new balance.

Required Changes  Update Reporting/LeaderboardRankingReportAppService, engagement reports, cache-key builders, SignalR contracts and query indexes. Prevent joins from multiplying aggregate results.

Dependencies  BE06 and BE07; BE05 governs cache invalidation after settings changes.

items.itemName: Admin Competition and Season Management
items.description:
As a Super Admin, I want competition and season management screens, so that I can configure leagues and cups and control their lifecycle without editing deployment files.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  The Catalog screen shows competition, format, seasons, provider coverage and Draft, Published or Archived status, with search and filters.
2  Season creation and editing expose names, dates and external identifiers. Validate required fields and display server errors without losing entered values.
3  Changing SyncEnabled targets the season identifier, not LeagueId alone. Update the interface only after server success; restore the previous value on failure.
4  Users without Super Admin privileges cannot access catalog mutation controls, and the API rejects direct attempts to bypass the interface.

Required Changes  Add Angular Admin routes, catalog lists, a season editor, generated proxies, localization and permission guards. Never expose provider keys.

Dependencies  BE01 and BE03.

items.itemName: Admin Tenant Competition Assignment
items.description:
As a Super Admin, I want a tenant competition assignment screen with defaults and clear selection modes, so that I can control each tenant offering safely and predictably.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  Show the approved plan, available competitions, AllEntitled or Selected mode, competition order and a valid default season.
2  On plan change, identify competitions losing access and affected prediction counts, and warn that history will be preserved before saving.
3  An empty Selected mode clearly previews that users will see no competitions. Do not silently convert it into all leagues.
4  After success, reload server-approved values and the configuration version. On conflict, request a reload. Tenant Viewers can read but cannot save.

Required Changes  Add a Tenant Competition Assignment tab and reuse ABP permission checks, with a before-and-after summary and confirmation in the administrative workflow.

Dependencies  BE05 and AD01.

items.itemName: Admin Match Operations and Reports
items.description:
As a tenant administrator, I want competition and season filters across operational screens, so that I can inspect fixtures, predictions, rankings and reports in one consistent context.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  Fixtures, predictions, leaderboards, ranking reports and standings use linked competition and season filters. Changing competition clears invalid season and stage selections.
2  Every row, detail view and export shows context. A league without groups must not require a Group field or produce an error.
3  Score override, force recompute and detail refresh retain existing permissions and audit season and tenant scope. Refresh does not bypass the provider budget.
4  If scope changes while loading, results from an older request must not appear under the new filter. Totals correspond to the latest successful request.

Required Changes  Update Angular admin fixtures, predictions, leaderboards, report filters and DTO renderers. Share filter state and export scope.

Dependencies  BE06, BE08 and BE10.

items.itemName: Admin Multi Season Sync Monitoring
items.description:
As a platform operator, I want per-season synchronization health alongside the shared provider budget, so that I can identify failed or stale competitions and trigger controlled recovery.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  The dashboard distinguishes the account entity budget from each season's health, showing last success, next run, deferred work, HTTP 429 and active fixtures.
2  A season sync request displays JobId and queued, running or failed status. Do not report success before the job completes.
3  When the budget is exhausted, display the deferral reason and reset time. Manual controls neither bypass limits nor create duplicate jobs.
4  Distinguish provider outage, missing subscription coverage and an ended season. Do not expose secrets or raw provider payloads.

Required Changes  Extend the existing Data Provider/Sync screen rather than creating a duplicate screen. Update health APIs, host permissions and localization.

Dependencies  BE03 and BE04.

items.itemName: Player Competition and Season Navigation
items.description:
As an end user, I want to select a competition and season with a clear default, so that I can follow the matches that interest me across several tournaments.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  Bootstrap displays authorized competitions and seasons only, in the configured order. A single competition must not create a redundant All option.
2  Select the user's last valid context, then the tenant default. All is an explicit option and does not conflict with first-league defaults.
3  Changing competition updates fixtures and related details and cancels older requests. Store context in the URL without credentials.
4  On access changes or when no competitions are available, use a valid fallback context or a clear empty state rather than displaying unauthorized cached data.

Required Changes  Update wc-app competition and season selectors, route-query state and bootstrap models. Provide horizontally scrollable mobile tabs with keyboard support and RTL/LTR layouts.

Dependencies  BE05 and BE06.

items.itemName: Player Fixtures Prediction and Standings
items.description:
As an end user, I want competition-aware fixture details, predictions and standings, so that league rounds and cup stages use the correct display and participation rules.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  Fixture cards and detail show competition, season, local kickoff time and live status. In All, a competition badge distinguishes fixtures without relying on color alone.
2  Predictions retain the current fixture identifier and display T-10 minutes, TBD, WinnerOnly and server rejection states. Do not persist prediction mutations offline.
3  League views show sports standings, group tournaments show group sections and knockout views show stages. Missing statistics must not appear as misleading zero values.
4  Missing provider predictions or global probability data appear as unavailable and remain separate from tenant community data. Loading, empty, error and stale states are distinct.

Required Changes  Update fixture cards, fixture detail, the prediction dialog, standings summaries and provider-prediction components. Use server-provided predictionMode and lockReason.

Dependencies  FE01, BE06 and BE08.

items.itemName: Player Predictions Season and Friends Rankings
items.description:
As a player, I want my prediction history and main or friends rankings filtered by competition and season, so that I understand where my points and rank come from.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  My Predictions shows context, outcome, base points, multiplier and final points. Season filtering returns that season's predictions only and preserves pagination.
2  Label Overall and season-specific rankings clearly. Main and friends requests use the same filters and display personal rank and gap within that scope.
3  Show season-specific streaks and explain that rankings differ from available reward balances. Do not recalculate balances from leaderboard totals.
4  After scoring updates or filter changes, previous-season rankings must not mix with the current season. Users outside the Top 10 see their personal rank according to the API contract.

Required Changes  Update history, leaderboard tabs, the friends toggle, points presentation and SignalR handling. Use the response scope rather than aggregating totals in the browser.

Dependencies  BE07, BE10 and FE01.

items.itemName: Player Links Localization and PWA Cache Safety
items.description:
As an Arabic or English-speaking player, I want shared links and cached screens to preserve the authorized season context, so that navigation remains usable and safe on mobile and PWA.

**Acceptance Criteria**
1  Opening a notification or share through Banky or BAS restores fixture context after authentication. Unauthorized access receives a safe message and never exposes another tenant's predictions.
2  Language changes update competition and season names, labels, accessible names and RTL/LTR layouts without losing selection. Use a defined fallback when translation is missing.
3  The service worker must not cache authentication, mutations or unapproved private data. Logout and tenant switching clear private state and the previous tenant's preferences.
4  At a 360px viewport, competition and season selection and keyboard navigation remain usable. Network loss shows stale or offline states without claiming an unconfirmed prediction succeeded.

Required Changes  Update share and deep-link routing, localization keys, service-worker rules, session cleanup and accessibility. Preserve existing launch adapters.

Dependencies  BE09, FE01, FE02 and FE03.
